title: Comparison of Conspicuity of Masses and Architectural Distortions Between Wide- and Narrow-angle Digital Breast Tomosynthesis Systems
official: Comparison of Conspicuity of Masses and Architectural Distortions Between Wide- and Narrow-angle Digital Breast Tomosynthesis Systems
summary: To compare narrow-angle digital breast tomosynthesis (DBT) and wide-angle DBT.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Women undergoing standard screening mammography.
* Ability to understand and sign consent.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant women.
* Women unable to consent.
* Male patients.
